## Task

Remove the File System Access API vault flow so the app opens straight on the dashboard in every browser. ADR 0001 already retired the vault; today it blocks the UI in Firefox and Safari ("File System Access API is not supported in this browser") because the `requiresVault` guard redirects `/dashboard` to `/`.

## Parent Story

Hosted-first pivot (ADR 0001): replace the vault flow with sign-in and a project list. This issue does only the removal; the project list follows in HFP-005.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The last commit that still contains the vault code is tagged `archive/vault-flow`.
- [ ] `HomeView.vue`, `VaultSelector.vue`, `stores/vault.ts` and their specs are removed.
- [ ] The `requiresVault` route meta and the `beforeEach` guard are removed; `/` renders the dashboard.
- [ ] No "vault" wording remains in `src/` (code, comments, UI text).
- [ ] `npm run code-quality` passes; the `showDirectoryPicker` type error is gone with the code.
- [ ] `notes/task-list.md`: LPM-001 section marked "superseded by ADR 0001"; the `showDirectoryPicker` item under pre-existing breakages is closed.
- [ ] After merge: issues #4–#9 closed as not planned, with a comment linking ADR 0001 and the archive tag.
